tldr: Morning batch, Aug 11: Anthropic makes Claude Sonnet 5's $2/$10 intro pricing permanent (cancelling the Sept 1 increase), OpenAI opens its frontier cyber models to approved Daybreak partners under governance, and 19 House Democrats demand AI CEOs testify over autonomous-hacking incidents. OpenAI ships ChatGPT Business premium seats plus a Zapier ChatGPT Work case study; the community trains a 1B LLM from scratch for ~$200 and calls DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 the 'killer app' driving DGX Spark sales.

articles.title: Claude Sonnet 5 Introductory Pricing Made Permanent
articles.summary: Anthropic makes the $2/$10 per M tokens intro price permanent, cancelling the $3/$15 standard price set for Sept 1.

articles.title: OpenAI Puts Frontier Cyber Models in More Trusted Hands
articles.summary: Approved Daybreak partners can use OpenAI's frontier cyber models to deliver authorized, governed cybersecurity services.

articles.title: 19 House Democrats Demand AI CEOs Testify on Security Incidents
articles.summary: Letter to Speaker Johnson seeks testimony from top US AI lab CEOs over autonomous hacking incidents and needed regulation.

articles.title: Premium Seats Coming to ChatGPT Business
articles.summary: Sign up by Aug 20 for $100 workspace credits and higher usage limits for teams' most demanding work.

articles.title: Zapier Transforms Marketing With ChatGPT Work
articles.summary: Zapier's marketing team cuts lead-funnel drop-offs, builds campaign assets and automates reporting with ChatGPT Work.

articles.title: 1B-Parameter LLM Trained From Scratch on 20B Tokens for ~$200
articles.summary: Developer trains a 1.1B-param model on 20B FineWeb tokens for ~$200 as a learning project — full writeup on r/LocalLLaMA.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Called 'Killer App' Driving DGX Spark Sales
articles.summary: r/LocalLLaMA argues V4 Flash 0731's coding ability is the catalyst pushing buyers toward NVIDIA GB10-based DGX Spark systems.
